name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.141.0 — The escape command's prevention-note step no longer prescribes the escape row's own id as a Gotchas entry's owner citation. That id embeds a timestamp, and the same sentence bans dates in exactly that section, so every entry written to the old instruction was classed as date narration and reddened the repo-wide narration scan. The step now prescribes the spec path the defect escaped plus the spec that fixes it, and says outright that the row id is never the citation. 7.140.0 — The client player's own chrome is now English-only: the two-language STRINGS table and the lang role are retired from lib/walk-page.js and design-atlas.js's clientRoute, closing an escaped defect where the page declared <html lang="en"> while rendering Japanese chrome. Every save on the player now acts only on the server's answer — a mark hides, the open count drops, a note clears or a reached label counts only once the server responds ok, and any refusal or network failure leaves the page unchanged and reports it in a new [data-wk="msg"] status slot instead of guessing ahead of the network. POST /client/__walk/confirm independently refuses with 409 while any question anchored to the journey's screens is unanswered, so a stale tab or a failed player script can no longer record a client sign-off over an open question. 7.139.0 — ADR-0013 returns the theme pick to /spec:mocks: a new THEME state lands between WALK and CLIENT, where the user authors two or three directions under design/theme/<kebab>/ (tokens re-valuing the wire register's eleven roles), theme shortlist opens a client pick over the seed's two dense screens served in each direction's roles, and the client picks on /client/theme.html. --mark theme-picked adopts the pick with the same discipline theme adopt once had (tokens copied, a confirmed ledger row), and from then on every mock the client walks in the player is served with ?theme=<kebab> — a link swap of the wire register's token file, never a redraw; the session's own atlas and review pages stay neutral. theme open and theme adopt are retired in favor of theme shortlist and --mark theme-picked; a host that already picked at sketch keeps a legacy path with no stop. design-atlas.js check no longer warns on a sketch-status mock still linking wire/ once marks.themePicked is set, and /spec:sketch's Theme step now runs theme state as its normal path, falling back to authoring directions itself only on a host that skipped mocks.
